description: This Java class 'DefaultTbOtaPackageService' implements OTA package management functionalities such as saving, updating, and deleting OTA packages within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with underlying services and handles entity actions logging.

classes.name: DefaultTbOtaPackageService
classes.description: Service class for managing OTA packages, including saving, updating, and deleting OTA package data, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an OTA package info record, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: saveOtaPackageData
methods.description: Stores OTA package data, calculates checksum if needed, and logs the operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an OTA package and logs the deletion action.
